name: Contagion Protocol
detailed_description:
A brutal, stylish pixel roguelike where the infected never stop coming.

The contagion has taken over. Civilization is crumbling. You're all that's left... and they're coming for you.

Contagion Protocol is a bullet-heaven meets survival-horror experience where you mow down endless waves of undead with orbiting blades, evolving weapons, and brutal upgrades — all wrapped in a gritty pixel aesthetic.

🔥 About the Developer

Contagion Protocol is being developed solo by an active duty military member during off-hours, late nights, and early mornings.

If you're into supporting indie underdogs grinding out passion projects — welcome aboard.

🧟 Survive the Spread

  • Enemies spawn endlessly — the more you kill, the more that spawn.

  • No traditional waves. Just you, your blades, and the bloodbath that never ends.

🔪 Arm Yourself. Evolve Your Weapons.

  • Start with a single cleaver.

  • Upgrade to five orbiting blades, spinning faster with bleed, knockback, and area effects.

  • Level up fast — choose between new weapons or passive perks every time.

💀 Face the Infected Horde

  • 15+ zombie variants: Exploders, sprinters, tanky brutes, and terrifying bosses.

  • Enemies get stronger the longer you survive — every second matters.

🎮 Simple Controls. Deep Chaos.

  • One stick to move, everything else is handled.

  • Perfect for quick runs or deep survival sessions.

🔥 Features

  • Dynamic enemy spawning — no quiet moments.

  • Melee & ranged evolutions.

  • Passive upgrades that stack & synergize.

  • Pixel art with juicy blood FX & motion trails.

  • Industrial metal soundtrack that amps up the chaos.

  • Killer game feel and crunchy hits.

  • Designed for high replayability & “just one more run” gameplay.

If you love Vampire Survivors, 20 Minutes Till Dawn, or Rogue: Genesia, this game will feel like home... until the zombies take it from you.

short_description: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (or better)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 750 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains pixelated violence, depictions of blood and gore, and combat against undead enemies.
The overall tone is dark and survival-focused, with themes of post-apocalyptic environments and intense action.
While stylized and non-photorealistic, player discretion is advised due to the intensity of enemy swarms and blood effects.
